node_notes.logger: This utility converts application status into printf-backed log messages using LOGI and LOGE. firmware/utils/logger/logger.h defines those macros, and firmware/app/app.c uses them for PWM success and failure reporting.
node_notes.tim1_ch1: This timer channel produces the configured PWM waveform after prescaler, auto-reload, PWM mode, compare, channel, output, and counter setup. The evidence is mx_tim1_init plus the LL_TIM_* calls in firmware/platforms/stm32/pwm_pa8.c.
node_notes.main_entry: This application entry owns button setup, LED actions, the one-time app_start call, and the bare-metal polling loop. The behavior is evidenced by application/main.c, including button callbacks, EventFlag, led_on, led_toggle, and printf.
node_notes.stdio_uart: This sink carries printf output through the configured console USART. application/main.c calls mx_basic_stdio_init and uses printf, while logger.h documents printf as the logging backend; no USART instance or port-qualified TX/RX pins are supplied.
node_notes.pwm_driver: This STM32 platform driver validates the requested frequency, initializes TIM1, configures PA8 for TIM1 alternate function, and enables the timer channel. firmware/platforms/stm32/pwm_pa8.c provides the pwm_pa8_start implementation and the HAL_GPIO_Init call.
node_notes.status_led: This interface represents the status LED operations performed by the application during startup and after a button event. application/main.c calls led_on and led_toggle with MX_STATUS_LED, but the supplied firmware does not provide a port-qualified pin for that LED.
node_notes.button_if: This interface initializes the generated button object and delivers BUTTON_EVENT_PRESSED to ButtonCb. The evidence is application/main.c through mx_button_0_getobject, button_init, button_register_callback, and button_enableit; no physical button pin is emitted because the supplied files do not identify one.
node_notes.app_start: This application module starts the PWM feature once after board and console setup. firmware/app/app.c calls pwm_pa8_start with APP_PWM_FREQUENCY_HZ and reports the result through the logger.
node_notes.pa8_output: This is the physical PWM output binding on PA8 using GPIO_AF1_TIM1. firmware/platforms/stm32/pwm_pa8.c explicitly sets GPIO_PIN_8 on GPIOA in alternate-function push-pull mode.

node_notes.pwm_success: This records successful timer startup, including the PA8 pin and configured frequency. The message is emitted by LOGI in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.led_initial: This establishes the initial visible LED state before the feature startup call. application/main.c invokes led_on with MX_STATUS_LED and prints a confirmation.
node_notes.system_init: This initializes the target system and its peripheral baseline before the application uses the console and board interfaces. application/main.c checks mx_system_init and returns on failure.
node_notes.clear_event: This consumes the pending event before performing the LED action so a single press is not repeatedly handled. application/main.c sets EventFlag back to zero.
node_notes.callback_setup: This connects BUTTON_EVENT_PRESSED to ButtonCb and enables event generation. application/main.c registers the callback, calls button_enableit, and then clears EventFlag before entering runtime.
node_notes.pwm_failure: This records that PWM initialization failed and PA8 remains inactive. The failure path is the LOGE branch in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.pwm_result: This branch reflects the boolean result returned by pwm_pa8_start. firmware/app/app.c selects LOGI for true and LOGE for false.
node_notes.stdio_init: This establishes the basic stdio path used by both direct printf calls and LOGI or LOGE. application/main.c invokes mx_basic_stdio_init and aborts startup if it fails.
node_notes.event_result: This branch tests whether ButtonCb has notified the loop by setting EventFlag to 1. The condition is explicit in application/main.c at the if statement inside while 1.
node_notes.start_features: This transfers control to the vendor-agnostic application module after board-facing initialization is complete. The call is app_start in application/main.c.
node_notes.poll_event: This is the continuously executing bare-metal polling point for the volatile EventFlag. application/main.c places the check inside while 1 rather than creating an RTOS task.
node_notes.pwm_start: This requests the configured PWM frequency of 1000 Hz from the platform driver. firmware/app/app.c passes APP_PWM_FREQUENCY_HZ to pwm_pa8_start.
node_notes.button_setup: This obtains and initializes the generated button object selected as BUTTON_0. application/main.c performs mx_button_0_getobject followed by button_init.
node_notes.log_toggle: This reports the completed LED transition over the console logging path. application/main.c emits printf with the text LED toggled.
node_notes.toggle_led: This changes the status LED state in response to one button press event. application/main.c calls led_toggle with MX_STATUS_LED.
node_notes.boot: This step represents entry into the firmware application before application-owned setup begins. The source location is application/main.c at the main function entry, after the Cube system glue is intentionally not modeled as application behavior.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot
  participant Main as application/main.c
  participant Console as USART console
  participant Button as Button interface
  participant App as firmware/app/app.c
  participant PWM as pwm_pa8.c
  participant TIM1 as TIM1 CH1
  participant LED as Status LED

  Boot->>Main: Enter main
  Main->>Main: mx_system_init
  Main->>Console: mx_basic_stdio_init
  Main->>Button: mx_button_0_getobject
  Main->>Button: button_init and button_register_callback
  Main->>Button: button_enableit
  Main->>Console: printf initialization messages
  Main->>LED: led_on MX_STATUS_LED
  Main->>App: app_start
  App->>PWM: pwm_pa8_start 1000 Hz
  PWM->>TIM1: mx_tim1_init and LL_TIM configuration
  TIM1->>PWM: Start TIM1 CH1 output
  alt PWM setup succeeds
    App->>Console: LOGI PWM started on PA8
  else PWM setup fails
    App->>Console: LOGE PWM initialization failed
  end
  loop Main loop polls EventFlag
    Button-->>Main: ButtonCb sets EventFlag to 1
    alt EventFlag equals 1
      Main->>Main: Clear EventFlag
      Main->>LED: led_toggle MX_STATUS_LED
      Main->>Console: printf LED toggled
    else No button event
      Main->>Main: Continue polling
    end
  end
